k12_operating_grants.label: Recognized provincial revenue excluding capital recognition
k12_operating_grants.match_note: Public, separate, francophone and charter authorities in the combined financial return; both Lloydminster boards excluded. Valhalla is excluded in 2022–23 only, matching the return. September headcount for the same school year includes ECS.
k12_operating_grants.limitation: Accrual provincial revenue excluding capital recognition and school-to-school revenue; excludes directly collected opted-out-board property taxes. Includes reported provincial pension contributions. Not cash grants or total provincial support. Classification changes in 2018–19; 2022–23 excludes Valhalla; 2023–24 includes draft Northland reporting.
k12_operating_grants.gap_reason: No verified recognized provincial operating-support observation on this boundary.

k12_operating_expenses.label: School-authority expenses excluding amortization
k12_operating_expenses.match_note: Same reporting-authority roster as the financial statements and school-year September headcount, including ECS. Excludes Lloydminster boards; also excludes Valhalla in 2022–23.
k12_operating_expenses.limitation: Combined school-authority expenses less reported amortization; includes non-instructional activities. 2022–23 excludes Valhalla; 2023–24 includes draft Northland reporting.
k12_operating_expenses.gap_reason: No verified combined school-authority expense observation on this boundary.

year_notes.2023: Valhalla restored; compilation includes draft Northland reporting.

k12_operating_expenses.delivery_gap: Published Budget columns do not establish original-versus-revised status; comparable budget amortization is not verified.

postsec_operating_grants.label: Department operating grants to 20 public institutions
postsec_operating_grants.period_basis: Provincial fiscal year: April–March; FLE academic reporting period
postsec_operating_grants.match_note: Annual departmental operating grants to the same 20 public institutions in the reported approved-program FLE count. Excludes Banff Centre and independent institutions. Fiscal grants are paired with the academic year starting in the same calendar year; periods overlap but are not identical.
postsec_operating_grants.limitation: All departmental operating-grant programs, not base grants alone; excludes separately reported infrastructure. Annual reported levels only; department-program boundaries are not fully harmonized. Earlier FLE may also be affected by thesis-reporting issues of unspecified duration. Reported FLE definitions change repeatedly. 2023–24 and 2024–25 system ratios are withheld because of documented reporting problems.
postsec_operating_grants.gap_reason: No verified department operating-grant observation on this boundary.

year_notes.2023: Ratio withheld: source reports University of Alberta thesis FLE over-reporting.
year_notes.2024: Ratio withheld: Athabasca extended reporting period and NorQuest duplicate session.

postsec_operating_grants.delivery_gap: The institution-level operating-grant schedules provide actuals and comparators; no matched original-budget series is verified.

postsec_operating_expenses.label: Expenses excluding amortization and identified capital disposal losses: three undergraduate universities
postsec_operating_expenses.period_basis: Institution financial year paired with the corresponding academic year
postsec_operating_expenses.match_note: Alberta University of the Arts, MacEwan University and Mount Royal University only. Their institutional expenses and approved-program FLE are summed separately from the 20-institution grants series.
postsec_operating_expenses.limitation: MacEwan, Mount Royal and Alberta University of the Arts only, not the full post-secondary sector. Expenses exclude tangible and intangible amortization and separately identified capital disposal losses; all other activities remain. Institutional fiscal and approved-program FLE reporting periods overlap approximately, not exactly. Not instructional cost or the province's operating-expense definition.
postsec_operating_expenses.gap_reason: No approved expense observation excluding amortization and identified capital disposal losses for this three-university subset.
postsec_operating_expenses.delivery_gap: No independently verified, comparable original operating-expense budget is admitted for this subset.
